message.content:
**Verdict: Mostly correct — 1 check passes, minor issues remain.**

1) **Close button: PASS.** The circular X is clearly visible (gold border, left side of modal) and no longer overlaps any body text — text has proper clearance.

2) **Remaining defects:**
- The modal overlaps the price table rows (3-month/4-month data hidden behind it) — acceptable for a dialog, but it also covers/cuts the large gold headline at top (text clipped mid-line, e.g. "الدا مقبول نت" partially cut) — that appears to be a page-level clipping issue, not the modal.
- Modal is left-aligned within its box, leaving empty space on the right; slight asymmetry in RTL layout.
- Table header rows hidden behind modal can't be verified for overlap.

Core fix (close button clearance) is done; cosmetic centering and the clipped headline remain.
